subject: Multilogit Regression Error In Categorical Function

messages.author: e043a8a0e96e2b12
messages.subject: Multilogit Regression Error In Categorical Function
parts:
Hello all,

while trying to do a multilogit regression using the example code from the Stan Manual 1.0.3 I encountered an error. Here's the message and the code I used.


 Error in function stan::prob::categorical_log(x): Number of categories is 3, but must be between (0, 2)

And here's the compiler version.

G__~1.EXE (GCC) 4.6.3 20111208 (prerelease)
Copyright (C) 2011 Free Software Foundation, Inc.
This is free software; see the source for copying conditions.  There is NO
warranty; not even for MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

 Maybe I'm doing something wrong, but I get this error with my own data as well as with the data from another user (which I included in my code).

Thanks for your help,
Moritz

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Multilogit Regression Error In Categorical Function
parts:
The support for the categorical distribution starts from 0, so you should have 

  for (n in 1:N)

    (y[n] -1) ~ categorical(softmax(beta*x[n]));


--

Jiqiang
